company_type: Small business software company (synthetic feasibility fixture)
goal: Deliver a customer-support portal pilot in two weeks. Week 1 must establish agreed request fields and acceptance criteria, a working API prototype, and a staging environment. Week 2 integrates, tests and pilots the portal with documented support and rollback procedures. Product supplies the field contract to Engineering; Engineering supplies the API build to Operations; Operations reports staging test findings back to Engineering. No real systems or customers are accessed.

departments.responsibilities: Requirements, field contract and acceptance criteria
API implementation, integration and defect resolution
Staging, testing, pilot support and rollback readiness
